selection: Each selected signature grants only its own ability. Optional named synergies apply when both signatures are separately known.

signatures.name: Bent Trajectory
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None — no roll

**Target / range / shape:** One of your spell attacks; choose one visible, unoccupied square within 6 squares of you before rolling.

Choose one of your spell attacks. It can originate from any visible, unoccupied square within 6 squares of you. Determine cover and attack path from that square, but measure range from you. You must know the target’s location. Roll the spell attack normally.

**Duration:** For that spell.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use this shaping once on your turn. It changes the origin of an existing spell attack and uses that spell’s action, roll and SP; it is not a separate spell.

signatures.name: Create a Window
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally during their turn, before their chosen step or attack resolves. Choose two visible, unoccupied squares within 6 squares of you.

The two squares become connected windows until the end of the ally’s turn. The ally can use the windows once at any point during their turn, either to move through one and out the other, spending 1 square of movement, or to make one attack through one window, measuring range and cover from the other. The ally must be able to see the window they use. The windows vanish at the end of the ally’s turn. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

**Duration:** Until the end of the ally’s turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP. The windows give the ally a route for its own movement or attack.

**Frequency:** Once per round.

signatures.name: Choose the Edge
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (use each spell’s casting attribute)

**Target / range / shape:** Your own single-target, instantaneous spell that requires a roll, before its roll.

Once per scene, choose two distinct legal targets. Resolve the spell separately against each, paying its SP cost once. This shapes the original casting rather than casting a second spell. Take 2 Banes on defense rolls until the start of your next turn. Use the spell’s ordinary range, action, casting requirements and effects for both resolutions.

**Duration:** Spell resolves immediately; defense penalty ends at the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Study the Pattern
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One known ongoing magical effect within 5 squares.

**Magic:** Spell · **SP:** 0

Study the effect once per scene. Roll Reason and learn 1/2/3 facts on Weak/Standard/Strong, chosen from its purpose, its remaining duration, and the category of its source (creature, object, place or independent spell). Gain 1 Boon to your next roll applying a learned fact this scene. The DA describes what the effect reveals, not unknown true names or hidden personal history.

**Duration:** Facts remain known; the Boon expires when used or at scene end.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

signatures.name: Reading the Weave
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One known ongoing magical effect within 5 squares.

Study the effect once per scene. Roll Reason and learn 1/2/3 facts on Weak/Standard/Strong, chosen from its purpose, remaining duration, and source category (creature, object, place or independent spell). Gain 1 Boon to your next roll applying a learned fact this scene. The DA describes what the effect reveals, not unknown true names or hidden personal history.

Your next cancellation roll against that effect this scene also gains 1 Boon. The examination reveals whether a specific remedy exists and the kind of evidence needed to discover it. Use the learned facts with your cancellation abilities or to seek the remedy.

**Duration:** Facts remain known; each Boon expires when used or at scene end.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP.

signatures.name: Open the Circle
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self and willing allies within 2 squares when used.

Each recipient gains 1 Boon to defenses against spells until the start of your next turn. During that time, each recipient gains Stability 2.

**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP. If you also know Study the Pattern or Reading the Weave, you can communicate facts already learned with either while creating the ward; others learn exactly the facts you know.

**Frequency:** A new ward replaces your previous ward.

signatures.name: Deliberate Spark
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None — no roll

**Target / range / shape:** One corner of your square; each creature in the four squares that share that corner and are in line of effect.

Choose a corner of your square and spark a brief flare of gas there. Each creature in the four squares that share that corner, including you, is pushed 2 squares directly away from that corner. A creature in more than one of those squares is pushed once. The spark does not provoke opportunity attacks. Resolve the push as forced movement; normal collision rules apply.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP, usable once on your turn. Its casting does not provoke opportunity attacks.

signatures.name: Arcane Deflection
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (roll the triggering defense normally)

**Target / range / shape:** Your defense against a spell, declared before rolling.

Once per scene, roll the defense and determine the spell’s damage before your resistance and other reductions. Prevent that spell event’s damage to you. Its other effects still apply. Choose a corner of your square; push each creature in a square sharing that corner and in line of effect, including yourself, directly away from that corner by the prevented damage amount, to a maximum of 3 squares. A creature spanning several squares is pushed once. Resolve Stability and collisions normally. This is a magical defensive effect, not another casting.

**Duration:** The triggering damage and immediate push.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Folded Aegis
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

For 2 hours, you are wrapped in magical heavy armor. You gain physical resistance 3, fire resistance 3 and cold resistance 3. Use the highest matching resistance for each damage type, to the normal cap of 3. The armor is weightless and needs no armor training.

**Duration:** 2 hours.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP, usable once between safe overnight rests. Its duration is fixed and requires no Sustain. Cancellation ends the armor; the cancellation progress target is 2.

signatures.name: Reckless Charge
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** Self, then one enemy within melee reach.

Once per scene, move up to 2 squares toward a visible enemy, following ordinary opportunity attack rules. Make one Basic Melee attack with your melee weapon against a creature you can reach. Take 1 Bane to defenses until the start of your next turn. This attack is part of the Maneuver and leaves your Main Action available.

**Duration:** Movement and attack immediate; defense penalty until your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A ready melee weapon.

signatures.name: Press On
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** Self, then one enemy within melee reach.

Move up to 2 squares toward a visible enemy, following ordinary opportunity attack rules. Make one Basic Melee attack with your ready melee weapon against a creature you can reach. After the attack, you may step 1 square to a legal empty square without provoking. The attack and step are part of this Maneuver and leave your Main Action available. Take 1 Bane to defenses until the start of your next turn; repeated uses do not multiply that penalty.

**Duration:** Movement and attack immediate; defense penalty until your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A ready melee weapon.

Use twice per scene. If you also know Reckless Charge, its uses count against these same two uses; learning both does not add a third charge.

signatures.name: Relentless Pursuit
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** A visible enemy within 2 squares when it begins voluntary movement.

After it finishes moving, move up to your Speed toward it without provoking. If you end adjacent, make one free Basic Melee attack against it using Brawn with 1 Boon. On a Weak result, apply Slowed 1. On a Standard result, apply Slowed 2. On a Strong result, apply Slowed 3. Slowed uses normal decay.

**Duration:** Immediate pursuit and attack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A melee weapon is required for the attack; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.

Use this Reaction once per scene. Follow legal movement routes and end in a supported free square; barriers still obstruct pursuit.

signatures.name: Measured Guard
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, before a defense against an adjacent enemy.

Gain 1 Boon to the defense. After the attack resolves, if the defense was Strong and the attacker is within your reach, make a Basic Melee attack against that attacker. This counterattack is part of the Reaction and does not use your Main Action.

**Duration:** The triggering defense and immediate counterattack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

You must wield a melee weapon to use this guard and counterattack. A granted counterattack cannot trigger another granted attack.

signatures.name: Return Stroke
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (roll the triggering defense normally)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, before a defense against an adjacent enemy.

Declare this guard before defending and gain 1 Boon to the defense. Resolve the triggering attack. After a Standard or Strong defense, if the attacker is still within your melee reach and you can attack, make one Basic Melee attack against it. The counterattack is part of this Reaction and does not use your Main Action. A granted counterattack cannot trigger another granted attack.

**Duration:** The triggering defense and immediate counterattack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A ready melee weapon.

signatures.name: Twitch Reflexes
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Each round you have one additional Reaction usable for an opportunity attack. Your normal Reaction remains available for any reaction you know. If you also know Measured Guard or Return Stroke, you may spend this additional Reaction on either instead. Use one of these guards against a given attack.

**Duration:** Permanent.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Cleave
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** All creatures adjacent to you, including allies. You must be wielding a melee weapon.

Make one Brawn roll using the least favorable net Boons/Banes among the targets. On a Weak result, deal 1 physical damage to each creature adjacent to you. On a Standard result, deal 1 physical damage and push each creature 1 square directly away from you. On a Strong result, deal 1 physical damage and push each creature 2 squares directly away from you. Resolve collisions normally.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Frequency:** Once on your turn.

signatures.name: Not So Fast
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** An enemy voluntarily entering your melee reach from outside it.

Make one Basic Melee attack with your melee weapon. On Standard or Strong, its movement ends and it cannot move again until the start of its next turn. On Weak, resolve the attack’s damage normally and the creature continues moving. This uses your ordinary Reaction.

**Duration:** Attack immediate; movement restriction until the target’s next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A ready melee weapon.

signatures.name: Dance Through Steel
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** Up to three distinct adjacent enemies.

Choose up to three distinct adjacent enemies and roll Agility once using the least favorable net Boons/Banes among them.

- **Weak:** Deal 4 physical damage to each.
- **Standard:** Deal 4 physical damage to each, then you may move up to 1 square without provoking.
- **Strong:** Deal 6 physical damage to each, then you may move up to 2 squares without provoking.

This is one signature attack against all chosen targets. Choose all targets before rolling.

**Duration:** Damage and movement resolve immediately.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a melee weapon; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.

Use this attack once per scene.

signatures.name: Spot the Leverage
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature or obstacle within 5 squares; you and each ally within 5 squares who can hear and understand you.

Choose one visible creature or obstacle within 5 squares. Learn one useful opening: for a creature, one of its defenses or one visible weakness; for an obstacle, whether Force can overcome it and its remaining progress target. You and each ally within 5 squares who can hear and understand you gain 1 Boon to your next action against the target before the start of your next turn.

**Duration:** Information persists; each Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use this on a given target once per scene. The DA describes observable defenses or weaknesses and the obstacle’s objective; hidden personal history is not revealed.

signatures.name: Diagnose the Failure
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** An ally within 5 squares that rolled Weak on an attack or objective attempt, before resolving it.

Once per scene, communicate an applicable correction the ally can perceive and understand. The ally rerolls with 1 additional Boon and uses the new result, including its natural dice. Resolve damage, conditions or progress only after that replacement roll.

**Duration:** The replacement roll.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Test the Hypothesis
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** One minute · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Time:** One minute.

**Target / range / shape:** Self and up to three allies who can hear and understand you.

Spend one minute forming a plan from the evidence and observations available. State the plan. The DA confirms what is true, what remains uncertain, and one contradiction or risk. You and each chosen ally gain 2 Boons to your next roll that directly follows the plan.

**Duration:** The plan and its stated limits remain known; each Boon expires when used or at the end of the scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Keep one plan at a time. A new plan replaces the previous plan and its unused Boons.

**Frequency:** Once per scene.

signatures.name: Make It Last
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Ritual — 1 hour · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** One ordinary item you own within reach.

**Magic:** Bound-item spell · **SP:** 1

Pay 1 SP and bind one item with a property chosen when bound: a lamp gives controllable ordinary torchlight; a tool returns to its bearer’s empty hand with a Maneuver from within 3 squares along a clear path; or a shield lets its bearer spend a Reaction once per scene to reduce one attack’s damage by 1 after rolling defense, respecting the attack’s minimum damage. You can have one bound item. A binding lasts until you end or replace it, even if the item is lent or lost. Cancellation target 3 ends its magic but leaves the ordinary item and occupied binding; restore the magic with a new ritual and SP. Lending or re-binding an item does not refresh its limited use.

**Duration:** Indefinite; no Sustain.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Suitable tools and the actual ordinary item.

signatures.name: Twofold Making
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Ritual — 1 hour · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** One ordinary item you own within reach.

**Magic:** Bound-item spell · **SP:** 1

Pay 1 SP and bind the item with one property chosen when bound: a lamp gives controllable ordinary torchlight; a tool returns to its bearer’s empty hand with a Maneuver from within 3 squares along a clear path; or a shield lets its bearer spend a Reaction once per scene to reduce one attack’s damage by 1 after rolling defense, respecting the attack’s minimum damage. A weapon may instead have this property: once per scene, before a weapon attack, its bearer converts that attack’s physical damage to fire or cold. Choose the type before rolling. Its damage amount and other effects are unchanged; this adds no second damage component. The converted attack is magical.

You may maintain two bound items on different ordinary objects. A binding lasts until you end or replace it, even if the item is lent or lost. Cancellation target 3 ends its magic but leaves the ordinary item and occupied binding; restore its magic with a new ritual and SP. Lending, replacing or re-binding an item does not refresh its limited use.

**Duration:** Indefinite; no Sustain.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Suitable tools and the actual ordinary item.

If you also know Make It Last, both signatures use this same two-item binding limit; their capacities do not add.

signatures.name: Masterwork Bond
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Ritual — 1 hour · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** One ordinary item you own within reach.

**Magic:** Bound-item spell · **SP:** 1

Pay 1 SP and bind the item with one property chosen when bound: a lamp gives controllable ordinary torchlight; a tool returns to its bearer’s empty hand with a Maneuver from within 3 squares along a clear path; or a shield lets its bearer spend a Reaction once per scene to reduce one attack’s damage by 1 after rolling defense, respecting the attack’s minimum damage. You may maintain three bound items on different ordinary objects.

One of those items may instead carry this masterwork property: once between your safe overnight rests, its wearer can spend a Reaction before one defense roll to gain 2 Boons. Track that use against your bond. A binding lasts until you end or replace it, even if the item is lent or lost. Cancellation target 3 ends its magic but leaves the ordinary item and occupied binding; restore its magic with a new ritual and SP. Lending, replacing or re-binding an item does not refresh its limited use.

**Duration:** Indefinite; no Sustain.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Suitable tools and the actual ordinary item.

If you also know Make It Last or Twofold Making, all your bindings share this three-item limit. Twofold Making’s weapon property is available only if you also know that signature.

signatures.name: Angle of Attack
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** One visible foe within 5 squares.

Study the foe. Until the start of your next turn, your next weapon attack against it may use Knowledge instead of its ordinary attribute. Use that attack’s actual range, weapon requirements, damage and effects. You may study once on your turn; a new study replaces the previous one.

**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Predict the Motion
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** One visible foe within 5 squares.

Study the foe. Until the start of your next turn, your next weapon attack against it may use Knowledge instead of its ordinary attribute. Use that attack’s actual range, weapon requirements, damage and effects. While this study lasts, you may also use Knowledge instead of Brawn or Agility to defend against that foe’s attacks; other defense attributes remain unchanged. You may study once on your turn; a new study replaces the previous one.

**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Shatter the Guard
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** One visible foe within 5 squares.

Study the foe. Until the start of your next turn, your next weapon attack against it may use Knowledge instead of its ordinary attribute. Use that attack’s actual range, weapon requirements, damage and effects. You may study once on your turn; a new study replaces the previous one.

Once per scene, after resolving that studied weapon attack, reduce one of the target’s existing resistances by 1, minimum 0, until scene end. Each target can suffer this reduction only once from Shatter the Guard, regardless of source. Immunity is unchanged.

**Duration:** Study until the start of your next turn; resistance reduction until scene end.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

If you also know Predict the Motion, its defense benefit applies while this study lasts.

signatures.name: Follow My Signal
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Up to two allies within 3 squares that can see or hear your Aid signal.

When you use Aid, you may assist two allies instead of one. Name the task for each and explain how your signal helps. Each gains Aid’s normal 1 Boon to its next matching roll before the start of your next turn. Outside combat, Aid still replaces your own contribution to a group roll.

**Duration:** Each Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Your signal may be speech, signs or music the recipients can perceive.

**Frequency:** One two-recipient Aid on your turn.

signatures.name: Press the Opening
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally within 4 squares that can perceive your signal.

Once per scene, the ally makes one Basic Melee or Basic Ranged attack with its actual weapon and ordinary range. The attack uses the ally’s roll and is part of your Maneuver. A Strong melee attack may also push its target 1 square directly away from the ally. A granted attack cannot grant another attack.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Coordinated Rush
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Two willing allies within 4 squares that can perceive your signal.

Each ally may move up to 3 squares without provoking, then make one Basic Melee or Basic Ranged attack against a legal target with its actual weapon. Resolve one ally completely before the other. On a Strong melee result, the attack may also push its target 1 directly away from the attacking ally.

**Duration:** Immediate movement and attacks.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use once per scene. Granted attacks cannot grant further attacks.

signatures.name: Lead the Way
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self; any willing allies within 3 squares who can see or hear you.

When you move using your Speed, any willing ally within 3 squares who can see or hear you may move with you at the same time, following your path, up to the distance you move, to a maximum of 2 squares. An ally who comes within 3 squares during your movement may join for the remainder of that movement. The allies spend no movement. This movement follows normal opportunity attack rules.

**Duration:** During your movement.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Spend the Maneuver before beginning the linked movement. Allies follow legal routes along your path and end in separate legal squares.

**Frequency:** Once on your turn.

signatures.name: Lead by Example
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One creature within reach of your melee weapon.

Attack with Guile: deal 2/4/6 physical damage on Weak/Standard/Strong. On Standard or Strong, each ally within 5 squares that can see or hear you may step 1 square without provoking. On Strong, those allies also gain 1 Boon to their next attack against the target before the start of your next turn.

**Duration:** Attack and steps immediate; Boons until used or your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A ready melee weapon.

**Frequency:** Once on your turn.

signatures.name: Watch the Rear
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally within 5 squares that can hear you, before its defense against an attack.

Grant 2 Boons to that defense. After the entire attack resolves, the ally may move up to 3 squares without provoking if still able.

**Duration:** The triggering defense and subsequent movement.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Stand Together
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self and one adjacent willing ally.

You and the ally gain 1 Boon to defense rolls while remaining adjacent, until the start of your next turn. Once per scene, before either recipient rolls one of these defenses, you may increase that defense’s benefit to 2 Boons, without an additional action.

**Duration:** Until your next turn or adjacency is lost.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Blow the Horn
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** Every enemy within 5 squares that can hear you.

Make one Guile roll and apply the result to each target. On a Weak result, apply Frightened 1. On a Standard result, apply Frightened 1 and Dazed 1. On a Strong result, apply Frightened 2 and Dazed 1.

**Duration:** Conditions use normal decay.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use once per scene. Roll using the least favorable applicable Boons/Banes. Apply hearing requirements and condition immunities normally.

signatures.name: Refuse the Rout
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self and up to three willing allies within 4 squares that can hear you.

Each recipient reduces one Frightened or Dazed condition by up to 2, to a minimum of 0, and gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn. Each may immediately move 1 square without provoking. Resolve movement in an order you choose. This applies to ordinary conditions.

**Duration:** Condition reduction and movement are immediate; Boons expire when used or the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use once per scene. A starred condition requires its own stated remedy.

signatures.name: The Bargain
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature within 8 squares.

**Magic:** Spell · **SP:** 0

Choose a patron or supernatural compact with the DA when learning this signature; your choices remain your own. Cast Pact Bolt for 2/3/5 force damage on Weak/Standard/Strong. Once per scene, before this roll, you may accept 1 Bane to defenses until the start of your next turn to gain 1 Boon on the bolt’s roll.

**Duration:** Attack immediate; accepted defense penalty until your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand.

signatures.name: Pact’s Claim
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature within 8 squares.

Cast a binding bolt for 2/3/5 force damage on Weak/Standard/Strong. Before rolling, you may choose to bind as well as wound: on Standard, reduce the damage by 1 and apply Slowed 1; on Strong, reduce the damage by 1 and apply Slowed 2. Weak deals its ordinary damage. Apply resistance and attack minimum normally; Slowed decays normally.

**Duration:** Attack immediate; Slowed uses ordinary decay.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand.

This is a spell costing 0 SP. If you also know The Bargain, you may use its once-per-scene defense-Bane bargain on this bolt; that remains the same limited use.

signatures.name: The Price Deferred
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self, when you would receive your third death failure.

**Magic:** Magical pact reprieve (not a spell)

Once between safe overnight rests, delay your death until the start of your next turn. You remain at 0 HP with three failures and make no further death rolls during this delay. Stabilization or healing above 0 clears the danger under ordinary recovery rules. At the start of your next turn, if you still have three failures, you die unless you spend Grit immediately. You can use this specific Reaction while Dying, even if unconscious.

**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Borrowed Tongue
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver

**Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self; one language you hear spoken.

A spirit that knows the language possesses you. You understand and speak that language for the scene. You do not read or write it.

**Duration:** Until the end of the scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

This is a consensual spirit invitation and a spell costing 0 SP. You retain control of your actions.

**Frequency:** Once per scene; one language at a time.

signatures.name: Out of Body
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Your body falls prone and cannot act, move or take Reactions. It has 3 defense Banes. Your spirit appears in your square or an adjacent free square.

The spirit has Speed 5, can speak, can pass through nonmagical solid objects and creatures, and is not a legal target for ordinary attacks. It cannot attack, cast spells, use equipment or physically interact with objects. Its movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Magical attacks can target it; resolve them against your normal defenses, and damage to the spirit is damage to your body. If your body drops to 0 HP, the projection ends.

At the end of your turn, choose one:

- **Snap Back:** Your spirit returns to your body.
- **Manifest:** Your body appears in the spirit’s square or the nearest free square that is not separated from your body by a solid barrier, prone. The projection ends.

If no legal Manifest square exists, you can only Snap Back.

**Duration:** Until the end of your turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP, usable once per scene. Attacks explicitly described as magical and spells may target the spirit; ordinary attacks target your body instead.

signatures.name: Borrowed Life
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

**Magic:** Spell · **SP:** 0

Once between safe overnight rests, invite a spirit’s expertise for the scene. Choose one named tool practice or one specific noncombat objective approach, such as interpreting old boundary stones. Gain 3 Boons to rolls using that expertise. The spirit lends mannerisms and speech while you remain in control. Use your own equipment and learned capabilities; the expertise is not weapon training or a spell repertoire.

**Duration:** Until scene end.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand.

signatures.name: Use Their Voice
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One enemy within 5 squares that can hear you; one willing ally within 5 squares that can see or hear you.

The spirit calls out in the target’s own voice from a point you choose within 5 squares. The target turns toward the voice. The ally may move up to 2 squares without provoking and gains 1 Boon to its next attack against that target before the start of your next turn.

**Duration:** Movement is immediate; the Boon expires when used or at the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP, usable once per scene. Turning toward the voice costs the target no action and does not compel any other behavior.

signatures.name: A Door Where There Wasn’t
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self; one nonmagical barrier within reach.

A door-sized opening appears in the barrier. Only you and your worn or carried gear can pass through it. The opening closes immediately after you pass through or at the end of your next turn.

**Duration:** Until you pass through or the end of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 1 SP, usable once per scene. The barrier can be at most 1 square thick, and you must see a safe, empty destination on its far side. Movement through the opening uses ordinary movement. Cancellation target 3 closes the opening.

signatures.name: The Unseen Procession
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** You and each ally within 5 squares; each enemy within 5 squares.

Once per scene, spectral figures fill the area. You and each ally gain 1 Boon to your next defense and may move 1 square without provoking. Each enemy gains 1 Bane to its next attack.

**Duration:** Until the end of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP. When the same attack would suffer both this spell’s attack Bane and its recipient’s defense Boon, apply only one of them.

signatures.name: Step Between
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent willing ally, after a single-target attack is declared against it but before rolling.

You and the ally swap squares. You become the target of the attack and resolve it against your defense. If either of you cannot occupy the other’s square, you cannot use this reaction. This does not redirect area attacks.

**Duration:** The triggering attack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Over My Body
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One ally within 3 squares.

When a single-target attack against an ally within 3 squares would bring them to 0 HP, or would damage an ally at 0 HP with two failure marks, move up to 2 squares to a square adjacent to that ally and take the damage instead. If that damage would bring you to 0 HP, stay at 1 HP.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Frequency:** Once per scene; uses your Reaction.

signatures.name: Take the Wound
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One ally within 5 squares.

Trigger: an ally within 5 squares would take damage that reduces it to 0 HP. Take the entire damage event instead, applying your own weaknesses and resistances once. The ally takes none of that event’s damage or attached conditions; you take its attached conditions. If you fall to 0, resolve your own Dying procedure.

**Duration:** Immediate. Attached conditions follow their usual timing.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use once per scene. A triggering attack may be redirected only once; resolve your own resistance once after redirection.

signatures.name: Healing Hands
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Self or one living creature you touch.

**Magic:** Spell · **SP:** 1

Restore 3/5/7 HP on Weak/Standard/Strong. Apply the recipient’s Life resistance, minimum 1 healing when HP is missing, and its maximum HP. Healing above 0 ends Dying and clears death marks normally. On Strong, also reduce one ordinary Bleeding, Burning or Freezing condition by 1.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand touching the recipient.

signatures.name: Restoring Hands
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Self or one living creature you touch.

Restore 3/5/7 HP on Weak/Standard/Strong. Apply the recipient’s Life resistance, minimum 1 healing when HP is missing, and its maximum HP. Healing above 0 ends Dying and clears death marks normally. Also reduce one ordinary Bleeding, Burning or Freezing condition by 1 on Weak or Standard, or by 2 on Strong. Choose the condition when healing. A starred condition still needs its own stated remedy.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand touching the recipient.

This is a spell costing 1 SP.

signatures.name: Sheltering Hands
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Self or one living creature you touch.

Restore 3/5/7 HP on Weak/Standard/Strong. Apply the recipient’s Life resistance, minimum 1 healing when HP is missing, and its maximum HP. Healing above 0 ends Dying and clears death marks normally. On Strong, also reduce one ordinary Bleeding, Burning or Freezing condition by 1. A starred condition still needs its own stated remedy.

After this healing, the recipient gains 2 Boons to its next defense before the start of your next turn. Once between safe overnight rests, as part of this healing action you may also stabilize a second adjacent Dying ally: it remains at 0 HP, clears its death marks and stops Dying.

**Duration:** Healing and stabilization immediate; defense Boons until used or your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand touching the healing recipient.

This is a spell costing 1 SP.

If you also know Restoring Hands, apply its condition reduction of 1/1/2 on Weak/Standard/Strong instead of this signature’s Strong-only reduction. This remains one healing action, not two castings.

signatures.name: Oathstrike
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Passive modifier to a melee weapon attack · **Attribute:** Use that attack’s attribute

**Target / range / shape:** An enemy that damaged one of your allies this scene.

**Magic:** Magical weapon modifier · **SP:** 1

Once on your turn, declare Oathstrike and pay 1 SP before a melee weapon attack against that enemy. Add 1/2/3 radiant damage to the attack on Weak/Standard/Strong. Resolve each damage component’s resistance, then apply the minimum once to the whole attack. This magical weapon modifier is not a separate spell casting and does not require a free hand beyond the weapon’s requirements.

**Duration:** The attack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** The actual melee weapon required by the attack.

signatures.name: Rebuking Light
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Passive modifier to a melee weapon attack · **Attribute:** Use that attack’s attribute

**Target / range / shape:** An enemy that damaged one of your allies this scene.

Once on your turn, declare this modifier and pay 1 SP before a melee weapon attack against that enemy. Add 1/2/3 radiant damage to the attack on Weak/Standard/Strong. On Standard or Strong, also push the target 1 square directly away from you. On Strong, also apply Dazed 1. Resolve each damage component’s resistance, then apply the minimum once to the whole attack. Resolve Stability, collisions and condition immunity normally.

**Duration:** The attack and immediate push; Dazed uses normal decay.

**Equipment / acquisition:** The actual melee weapon required by the attack.

This magical weapon modifier is not a separate spell casting and requires no free hand beyond the weapon’s requirements.

signatures.name: Radiant Threshold
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** A straight line starting from a point you can see within 5 squares.

Make a Reason roll. Weak: 3 squares long; 1 radiant damage. Standard: 5 squares long; 2 radiant damage. Strong: 7 squares long; 3 radiant damage. The line is 1 square wide and lasts until the start of your next turn. You and allies you choose when you create it are unaffected. A creature takes the damage when the line appears in its square, when it enters a square of the line, or when it starts its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per round. The line does not block movement.

**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 2 SP, usable once per scene. You may have one threshold at a time; creating another ends it. Each creature takes its zone damage at most once per round. Damage dealt by occupying/crossing the persistent zone is non-attack damage and can be reduced to 0.

signatures.name: Blade in the Back
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One creature within reach that has not noticed you or is adjacent to one of your allies.

Make an Agility roll against the target. Weak: 3 physical damage. Standard: 4 physical damage, and the target has Bleeding 1. Strong: 6 physical damage, and the target has Bleeding 2.

**Duration:** Immediate; Bleeding uses its normal decay.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A melee weapon.

signatures.name: Hamstring
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One creature within melee reach that has not noticed you or is adjacent to one of your allies.

Make an Agility roll against the target. On Weak, deal 3 physical damage and apply Slowed 1. On Standard, deal 4 physical damage and apply Bleeding 1 and Slowed 2. On Strong, deal 6 physical damage and apply Bleeding 2 and Slowed 3. This is one attack, not an additional attack. Apply condition immunity and normal decay.

**Duration:** Attack immediate; conditions use normal decay.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A melee weapon.

signatures.name: The Half-Second
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** The triggering creature within the ordinary range of your ready weapon; use Basic Melee reach or Basic Ranged range as appropriate.

Trigger: another creature you can see declares an action. Make an Agility attack roll with a weapon against the target. Weak: 3 physical damage. The triggering action resolves. Standard: 5 physical damage. The triggering action is interrupted and lost. Strong: 7 physical damage, and the target has Dazed 1. The triggering action is interrupted and lost.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A weapon.

Use this Reaction once per scene. Declare it before the target resolves its triggering action; resolve this signature first. It grants no further attacks.

signatures.name: Fade Behind
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Disengage. Then attempt to Hide with 1 Boon, even if you are currently observed, provided you have cover or obscurement. You still make the ordinary Hide attempt. If you succeed, you are Hidden until you attack, are revealed, or the concealment ends.

**Duration:** Immediate; Hidden uses its normal duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Frequency:** Once on your turn.

signatures.name: Open the Way
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** A lock, trap or barrier you work on with ordinary actions or a learned technique.

When your roll makes progress on a lock, trap or barrier, you may make that work quiet and leave no obvious trace of your tools on Standard or Strong. On Weak, make the normal progress with the ordinary noise and marks. Observers watching you can still see your work. Use the underlying action’s time, tools, progress and other effects.

**Duration:** The attempt.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Suitable tools for the task.

signatures.name: One with the Dark
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Once per scene, while you are in dim light or darkness, become Hidden until you attack, are revealed, or enter bright light. While Hidden this way, you always roll with 3 Boons to stay hidden or remain concealed. You can move normally; the DA judges whether the concealment and your route are plausible.

**Duration:** Until you attack, are revealed, or enter bright light.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Frequency:** Once per scene.

signatures.name: Fast Talk
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One creature within 5 squares that can hear and understand you.

State the social goal you are pursuing and what you want the target to do. Make a Guile roll. The result adds progress toward that goal: Weak: 2 progress. Standard: 3 progress. Strong: 5 progress. The DA sets the progress target before the roll. When the total reaches it, the target agrees within its wants and limits. This does not compel self-harm, betrayal, or a change to its loyalties.

**Duration:** Immediate progress; the negotiation persists.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Repeated attempts toward the same objective require a new meaningful contribution; use the DA’s objective and progress rules.

signatures.name: Read the Room
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One creature within 5 squares that you can see.

Make a Guile roll against the target. An intent is what the creature wants from this exchange or what it means to do next. Weak: learn one intent. Standard: learn one intent, and gain 1 Boon to your next social roll against it. Strong: learn one intent, and gain 2 Boons to your next social roll against it.

**Duration:** The scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Information about intention does not compel the target to follow that intention.

**Frequency:** Once per scene per creature.

signatures.name: The Cutting Word
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One creature within 10 squares that can see or hear you.

Make a Guile roll against the target. The jab can be a spoken barb, a gesture, or a look. Weak: the target has Dazed 1. Standard: the target has Dazed 1 and Frightened 1. Strong: the target has Dazed 2 and Frightened 1, and it cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn.

**Duration:** Conditions use their normal decay.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use once per scene. Apply condition immunity normally.

signatures.name: Mend
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One living ally within 3 squares.

pay 1 SP before rolling. You must have enough SP to pay this cost. Requires a free hand. Make a Reason roll. Weak: restore 3 HP. Standard: restore 6 HP. Strong: restore 9 HP, and the target may stand without spending movement. Reduce the restored amount by the target's Life resistance, to a minimum of 1 if HP is missing, and never exceed maximum HP. A Dying or stabilized living creature can receive this healing. This does not erase scars or restore the dead.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand.

This is a spell; use its printed 1 SP cost and ordinary casting rules.

signatures.name: Triage
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One or two living allies within 3 squares.

Pay 2 SP before rolling. You must have enough SP to pay this cost. Requires a free hand. Make a Reason roll. Choose one or two allies. One ally: restore 6 HP on Weak, 11 HP on Standard, 16 HP on Strong. Two allies: restore 4 HP each on Weak, 7 HP each on Standard, 10 HP each on Strong. Reduce the restored amount by each target's Life resistance, to a minimum of 1 if HP is missing, and never exceed maximum HP. A Dying or stabilized living creature can receive this healing. This does not erase scars or restore the dead.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand.

This is a spell.

signatures.name: The Shepherd's Call
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** 10 minutes · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Up to three willing characters.

Mark each target with a physical sigil. The first time a marked character would be reduced to 0 HP, it remains at 1 HP instead; the mark then disappears. An unused mark fades at the coming dawn. A character can bear only one mark from this ability.

**Duration:** Until used or dawn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a ritual spell costing 0 SP, usable once between safe overnight rests. Unused sigils expire at dawn; a creature may bear one sigil at a time.

signatures.name: Steady Voice
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One ally within 3 squares that can hear and understand you.

Make a Guile roll. Choose Frightened or Dazed on the target. Weak: reduce that condition by 1. Standard: reduce it by 1, and the target gains 1 Boon to its next roll to resist fear or Daze. Strong: reduce it by 2, and the target gains 1 Boon to its next roll to resist fear or Daze. If the target has neither condition, it gains the Boon on a Standard or Strong result.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

An unused Boon expires at the start of your next turn. This reassuring voice is an ordinary ability, not a spell.

signatures.name: The Fold
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** A 3 × 3 area centered on a point within 5 squares.

Call divine energy. The area becomes the Fold until the end of your next turn. You and each ally in the Fold gain 1 Boon to all rolls. The Fold does not move. As a Maneuver on a later turn, you can sustain the Fold until the end of your next turn. Sustaining costs the Maneuver and requires you to be able to act.

**Duration:** Until the end of your next turn; sustained one round at a time.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP. Sustain with a Maneuver and 0 SP, for up to 1 minute; it occupies your one sustained-spell allowance.

**Frequency:** Once per scene to create; later upkeep spends a Maneuver.

signatures.name: The Shared Cup
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Two willing creatures within 5 squares, one donor and one recipient. You can be either.

Move up to 6 HP from the donor to the recipient. The donor must remain above 0 HP. The recipient cannot exceed maximum HP. Move the same amount out of the donor’s HP and into the recipient’s HP, ignoring Life resistance. If the recipient rises above 0 HP, clear both death roll tallies and end Dying and HP-caused unconsciousness.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP, usable once on your turn. The donor must stay above 0 HP. Transfer only existing HP into missing HP, ignoring Life resistance on this transfer; the amount removed equals the amount restored.

signatures.name: Borrowed Shape
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

**Magic:** Spell · **SP:** 1

Once per scene, assume the appearance of a familiar Small or Medium ground beast for 10 minutes. Keep your HP, attributes, conditions, resources and Speed. Your equipment melds and provides no effects or resistance. Your form has physical resistance 1 and a natural attack: Main Action, Brawn, adjacent target, 2/3/5 physical damage on Weak/Standard/Strong. You speak only animal calls and cannot cast spells or use equipment. Return to your own shape with a Maneuver or automatically at 0 HP. Changing form never restores HP.

**Duration:** Fixed 10 minutes; no Sustain.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand to cast before transforming.

signatures.name: Shape of the Wild
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Once per scene, assume the appearance of a familiar Small or Medium ground beast for 10 minutes. Keep your HP, attributes, conditions, resources and Speed. Your equipment melds and provides no effects or resistance. Your form has physical resistance 1 and a natural attack: Main Action, Brawn, adjacent target, 2/3/5 physical damage on Weak/Standard/Strong. You speak only animal calls and cannot cast spells or use equipment. Return to your own shape with a Maneuver or automatically at 0 HP. Changing form never restores HP.

Choose one adaptation when transforming: swim at your Speed and breathe water; climb at your Speed; or remain a ground beast and gain 1 Boon to tracking rolls that rely on scent. It lasts for this transformation. Changing it requires another casting and follows this signature’s once-per-scene limit.

**Duration:** Fixed 10 minutes; no Sustain.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand to cast before transforming.

This is a spell costing 1 SP. If you also know Borrowed Shape, both signatures share the same once-per-scene transformation use.

signatures.name: Great Shape
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Once per scene, transform for 10 minutes into a familiar Small, Medium or Large ground beast, or a Small flying beast. Choose a legal space large enough for the form. Keep your HP, attributes, conditions, resources and Speed, and gain physical resistance 1. Your equipment melds and provides no effects or resistance. You speak only animal calls and cannot cast spells or use equipment. Return to your own shape with a Maneuver or automatically at 0 HP. Changing form never restores HP.

A Small or Medium ground beast has a natural Main Action attack using Brawn against an adjacent target for 2/3/5 physical damage. A Large ground beast has a natural Main Action attack using Brawn against an adjacent target for 3/4/6 physical damage; Strong also pushes the target 1 square directly away. A Small flying beast gains fly Speed equal to your Speed and a natural Main Action attack using Brawn against an adjacent target for 2/3/5 physical damage. Returning to your own form while airborne leaves you subject to falling normally.

**Duration:** Fixed 10 minutes; no Sustain.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand to cast before transforming.

This is a spell costing 1 SP. If you also know Borrowed Shape or Shape of the Wild, all share the same once-per-scene transformation use. Shape of the Wild’s adaptation is available only if you also know that signature.

signatures.name: Go Berserk
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Enter a rage until the end of the scene. While raging, you gain 1 Boon to attack rolls, have 1 Bane to defense rolls, and gain physical resistance 1. You can end the rage at will. It also ends if you fall unconscious or enter Dying.

**Duration:** Until the end of the scene, or until you end it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Frequency:** Once per scene.

signatures.name: Pain Feeds the Fire
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Enter a rage until the end of the scene. While raging, gain 1 Boon to attack rolls, 1 Bane to defense rolls, and physical resistance 1. You can end the rage at will. It also ends if you fall unconscious or enter Dying.

When an enemy damages you during this rage, gain 1 Boon to your next attack before the end of your next turn. Repeated damage does not accumulate these Boons. Damage you or an ally deliberately deal to you, and hazards you deliberately enter to hurt yourself, do not trigger it. Hostile forced movement into a hazard does trigger it.

**Duration:** Rage until scene end or until ended; damage-triggered Boon until your next attack or the end of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use once per scene. If you also know Go Berserk, both signatures share that rage use.

signatures.name: Deathless Rage
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Enter a rage until the end of the scene. While raging, gain 1 Boon to attack rolls, 1 Bane to defense rolls, and physical resistance 1. You can end the rage at will. It also ends if you fall unconscious or enter Dying.

Once per scene, when damage would reduce you to 0 HP during this rage, remain at 1 HP. If you regain HP before the end of your next turn, the reprieve ends and you keep that HP. Otherwise, fall to 0 HP and begin Dying at the end of that turn. Further damage can still bring you to 0 during the reprieve. If you survive reaching 0, record a scar as usual.

**Duration:** Rage until scene end or until ended; reprieve until the end of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use this rage once per scene. If you also know Go Berserk or Pain Feeds the Fire, all share that rage use. Pain Feeds the Fire’s damage-triggered Boon applies only if you also know that signature.

signatures.name: Charge
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** One creature at least 2 squares away and within your Speed, in a straight line.

Move up to your Speed in a straight line toward the target. This movement provokes normally. If you end adjacent to it, make a Brawn roll against it. Weak: 2 physical damage, and push it 1 square. Standard: 3 physical damage, push it 2 squares, and it is Prone. Strong: 5 physical damage, push it 3 squares, and it is Prone. Resolve collisions normally. If you cannot move at least 2 squares, you cannot use this ability.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Movement used in the approach spends your remaining movement for the turn, rather than granting a second full Speed allowance.

signatures.name: Rampage
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** Self; a straight line up to your Speed.

This ability consumes your Main Action and your movement for the turn. Move up to your Speed in a straight line. Each enemy within 1 square of your path takes 2 physical damage and is pushed 1 square directly away from the path. Then make a Brawn roll against one enemy adjacent to you at the end of the movement. Weak: 3 physical damage. Standard: 4 physical damage, and it is Prone. Strong: 6 physical damage, and it is Prone. If you cannot move at least 2 squares in a straight line, you cannot use this ability. You cannot move again after the charge.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

A creature takes the path damage at most once per use. The endpoint attack is a separate damage event.

**Frequency:** Once per scene.

signatures.name: Earthbreaker
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** Self; each enemy within 2 squares.

Make a Brawn roll and apply it to every enemy in range. Weak: 2 physical damage, and push 1 square directly away from you. Standard: 4 physical damage, push 2 squares, and it is Prone. Strong: 6 physical damage, push 3 squares, and it is Prone and Dazed 1. Structures and unattended objects in the area take double damage. Resolve collisions normally. This does not move you.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use ordinary object HP, resistance and collision rules. Fixed barriers stop forced movement even if the damage breaks them.

**Frequency:** Once per scene.

signatures.name: Grab and Hurl
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent creature your size or smaller.

Make a Brawn roll against the target. Weak: it has Grappled 1. Standard: throw it up to 2 squares in a direction you choose; it lands Prone. Strong: throw it up to 3 squares in a direction you choose; it lands Prone and takes 2 physical damage. Resolve collisions normally. The throw ends any grapple from this ability.

**Duration:** Immediate; Grappled and Prone use their normal rules.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Requires a free hand and a target your Size or smaller. A control-only Weak result deals no damage; it does not acquire an attack damage minimum.

signatures.name: Over the Top
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally your size or smaller within reach.

Throw the ally up to 4 squares in a direction you choose, ignoring difficult terrain and passing over occupied squares. The ally must land standing in a free square. If it lands adjacent to an enemy, it may immediately make one Basic Melee attack against that enemy with 1 Boon. That attack is part of your action, not the ally's turn. The ally takes no damage from the throw.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand; the ally needs a ready melee weapon or free hand for its Basic Melee attack.

Use once per scene. The landing square must be legal and empty; a granted attack cannot grant further attacks.

signatures.name: The Cannonball
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** One creature within 4 squares.

Move up to 4 squares in a straight line toward the target, ignoring difficult terrain. If you end adjacent to it, make a Brawn roll. Weak: 4 physical damage to the target. You take 3 physical damage and are Prone. Standard: 8 physical damage, and the target is Prone. You take 2 physical damage. Strong: 12 physical damage, and the target is Prone and Dazed 1. You take 1 physical damage and are Dazed 1. If you cannot move at least 2 squares, you cannot use this ability. Resolve collisions normally.

**Duration:** Immediate; Prone and Dazed use their normal rules.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

Use once per scene. Its self-inflicted damage is non-attack damage, reduced by matching resistance to a minimum of 0; it is not an HP payment. It cannot trigger Pain Feeds the Fire.

signatures.name: Steady Aim
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self; one visible creature.

Aim at one visible creature. Until you move, you gain 1 Boon to all attacks you make against that creature and ignore partial cover from it.

**Duration:** Until you move.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A ranged weapon and ammunition.

The benefit ends when you aim at another target or the scene ends. You must still perceive your target to attack it.

signatures.name: Volley
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** A 2 × 2 area within 10 squares.

Requires a ranged weapon and ammunition. Make one Agility roll and apply it to each creature in the area. Weak: 1 physical damage. Standard: 2 physical damage. Strong: 3 physical damage. Roll once using the worst applicable Boon or Bane among the targets. Each target applies resistance separately. A creature can be affected once per use.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A ranged weapon and ammunition.

signatures.name: Mark the Quarry
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature within 12 squares.

Requires a ranged weapon and ammunition. Make a Basic Ranged attack as part of this action. After the attack resolves, the target is marked for one day with the glowing dust of a cave mushroom. While marked, you and each ally who can see it gain 2 Boons to any attack against it, ignore partial cover from it, and the target cannot hide. The mark deals no additional damage.

**Duration:** One day.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A ranged weapon and ammunition.

This ordinary mark is a physical luminous substance. An attack always applies it unless the target cannot be reached; damage immunity does not prevent marking. Cleaning it off takes 1 minute. Completely covering the mark suspends its visual benefits until exposed.

**Frequency:** Once between safe overnight rests.

signatures.name: Beast Speech
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

For the scene, you can speak with animals. You can ask questions and understand their replies, limited by what the animal has experienced and can understand. You gain 1 Boon to all rolls interacting with animals you are speaking with. This does not make an animal friendly or obedient, and does not compel it to act against its nature.

**Duration:** The scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand for casting.

This is a spell costing 0 SP. Animals retain their motives and agency. A companion acquired through play uses its actual profile.

**Frequency:** Once per scene.

signatures.name: Wild Partnership
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** A willing living beast within 6 squares that can perceive your signal.

Once per scene, the beast may move up to its Speed and perform one ordinary nonattack task such as fetching, tracking or carrying. This is the beast’s activity for the round rather than an additional turn. Outside these commands the DA portrays its ordinary independent behavior.

**Duration:** Immediate movement and task, or the ordinary time that task needs.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Call the Wild
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None

**Target / range / shape:** One willing wild companion arriving in a visible empty square within 6 squares.

**Magic:** Spell · **SP:** 2

Once per scene, call your bonded companion with 2 SP. Its profile is: Size Medium; HP 16; Speed 6; physical resistance 1; Brawn +1, Fortitude +1, Agility +1, Guile 0, Knowledge −1, Reason 0; Stability 0. Its natural Main Action attack uses Brawn against an adjacent target for 2/4/6 physical damage; Strong also applies Prone. It has the ordinary movement and basic actions its body can perform. You control its rolls. Once on your turn, command it within 6 squares: your Main Action grants it one Main Action and movement; your Maneuver grants it one Maneuver and movement. It receives no separate combat turn and has no Reaction. Without a command it defends normally but takes no combat actions. It is a living creature, can heal, and uses the normal Dying rules at 0 HP. You can have one bonded companion. Further castings recall that same creature with its current HP and conditions; casting neither restores nor revives it. It remains when uncommanded. If it dies or is released, finding a new willing companion requires a safe overnight rest and the DA’s appropriate wilderness fiction; the bond, not each casting, determines the creature.

**Duration:** Indefinite companionship; summoning is immediate and requires no Sustain.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand.

signatures.name: Twin Strike
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One or two creatures within reach.

Requires two light melee weapons, one in each hand. Make one attack with each weapon. Each attack uses your normal attack procedure and deals 1 physical damage on Weak, 2 on Standard, 3 on Strong. You can target the same creature with both attacks or one creature with each. After the attacks, gain 1 Boon to defense until the start of your next turn.

**Duration:** Immediate; the defense Boon lasts until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Two light melee weapons, one in each hand.

signatures.name: Through Bramble
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One or two creatures within melee reach.

Make one attack with each of two light melee weapons, one in each hand. Each attack uses your normal attack procedure and deals 1/2/3 physical damage on Weak/Standard/Strong. You can target the same creature with both attacks or one creature with each. After the attacks, gain 1 Boon to defense until the start of your next turn.

Once on your turn, after resolving both attacks, you may step 1 square to a legal empty square without spending movement or provoking opportunity attacks. Use ordinary terrain and movement restrictions for that step.

**Duration:** Attacks and step immediate; defense Boon until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Two light melee weapons, one in each hand.

signatures.name: Death from the Blind Spot
signatures.rulesMarkdown:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One creature you have damaged or tracked this scene.

This ability consumes your Main Action and your movement for the turn. Move up to 6 squares to a square adjacent to the target, ignoring difficult terrain and without provoking. Then make one melee attack with 1 Boon. Weak: 6 physical damage. Standard: 9 physical damage, and the target is Prone. Strong: 12 physical damage, and the target is Prone and Dazed 1. If you cannot reach a square adjacent to the target, you cannot use this ability.

**Duration:** Immediate; Prone and Dazed use their normal rules.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A melee weapon.

**Frequency:** Once per scene.
